about: More templates for the AnimBlueprint Maker (Make AnimBlueprint and Make Editable AnimBlueprint), with no new build: each one the game's own AnimBlueprint of a character, its cooked package <package>.uasset and its decoded <package>.template.json next to this file. The Maker lists cloud, sephiroth, vincent and monster, then these.
